title: Wayfare Pass Plan Schedule — Payment Recovery Fee
content:
# Payment recovery fee — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

A restoration payment on a past-due Wayfare Pass membership carries a payment recovery fee scaled to how many times the renewal was declined. The payment recovery fee depends on the declined attempts recorded on the period's renewal: 1.00 at three or more attempts, 0.50 at exactly two, nothing at one.

| Declined attempts recorded on the renewal of the billing period in force | Payment recovery fee (USD) |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 1.00 |
| exactly 2 | 0.50 |
| 1 | nothing |

**What counts as an attempt.** Every declined attempt on the membership ledger for the renewal of the billing period in force: the scheduled attempt and each retry.

**How the fee is charged.** The fee is added in full to the restoration payment, alongside the membership fee the payment collects; the total is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Edges.** Three declined attempts carry 1.00 and so do four; two carry 0.50; one carries nothing.

**Hypothetical figure.** A Wayfare Pass Monthly restoration that collects the full 9.99 fee after the scheduled attempt and two retries were declined (3 attempts): 9.99 and the 1.00 fee make 10.99.
